stories.title: A window left open
stories.summary: For a moment, the whole street was quiet enough to hear the curtains move.
stories.body: Across the courtyard, one window stayed lit. A spoon touched the side of a cup, then the light went out. The curtains lifted again. For once, there was nothing else I needed to do.

stories.title: One last star
stories.summary: I watched a small light cross the sky and forgot to make a wish.
stories.body: Maybe it was a plane. Maybe someone in a window seat was watching the lights below, trying to guess which one was home. I pulled the blanket to my chin and let the thought drift on.

sounds.title: The Midnight Tide
sounds.detail: Gentle waves on a quiet shore
